ERROR_POLICY: Outer except attempts one bounded error emit then exits2; if error emit fails it is swallowed, causing missing evidence rather than successful reconstruction
FORMULA: Per record N+(N-1)+...+1=N(N+1)/2; every successful call advances at least1; zero/error ends emit. Three admitted records provide conservative maximum, not exact attainable data size.
INTERRUPTED_WRITE_POLICY: No explicit payload InterruptedError retry. Python/runtime syscall restart behavior is outside source API-call arithmetic and requires separate domain definition if counted.
RETRY_POLICY: Positive short-write suffix continuation within same emit only; no service/probe relaunch retry authorized
ZERO_PROGRESS_POLICY: n<=0 raises OUTPUT_WRITE; no loop retry for zero progress
